verdict.rationale: Sentry's own web API documentation states it can be used to "manage and export data," and a published OpenAPI schema covers the full /api/0/ surface, so a programmatic export path exists. Nothing documents a complete, one-shot export of all account data, the formats exported, or an exit workflow; the documented relocation tooling covers only self-hosted-to-SaaS moves. Self-hosting as an 'escape hatch' is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented full-account bulk export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/OTLP), a documented SaaS-exit or migration-out path, and hands-on corroboration that exports are complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API"
